rounds.text: The business exhibits fundamentally weak profitability metrics, evidenced by a low return on equity of 4% [E23] and a trailing ROCE of only 5.6% [E6], which even trails the sector median ROCE of 6.3% [E74]. Compounded growth figures reveal medium-term deterioration, with 3-year sales contracting by 6% [E10] and 3-year profits plunging by 41% [E14], alongside an operating margin collapse from 19% down to 6% over a three-year window [E24]. Valuation is unsupportable based on fundamental DCF modeling, yielding an intrinsic value of Rs 173 that leaves a negative margin of safety of -32.6% [E40], while a reverse DCF indicates the current price already bakes in 4.0% earnings growth [E41]. Market sentiment confirms this lack of appeal through negative institutional money flow [E38], a lagging relative-strength rating of 22 against the Nifty 500 [E45], and a rules-based screen scoring a low 46 out of 100 resulting in a sell rating [E60]. Furthermore, reported earnings are flattered by non-operating factors, specifically containing Rs 63.4 Cr in other income [E57], and working capital efficiency is deteriorating as debtor days have risen from 31.8 to 40.6 days [E59]. Conceded: [E28], [E29], [E30], [E31], [E32], [E33].
